[SWS_DM_00941] Re-entrant ara::diag interface calls for DID read pro- cessing
⌈
The DM shall only call a read DID processing method on an interface for
service processing in a re-entrant way if it is:
• in default session and
• multiple conversation requests are being processed simultaneously and
• the requested diagnostic service requires that the DM is calling methods on
class
Namespace1OfPortInterface::Namespace2OfPortInterface:-
:ShortnameOfDIPortInterface or ara::diag::GenericDataIdenti-
fier and the same required port for different clients and
• the interface constructor has the parameter ara::diag::DataIdentifier-
ReentrancyType and
• the value of read is set to kFully. ⌋
